requirements.text: Jack 23 Nov 2026 asks to action Pedro's outstanding emailed updates and keep the version review ready. Only new website request: Pedro 20 Nov final Terms clause amendments (PDF sha256 391275969fa5...), confirmed by his 21 Nov WhatsApp. Private evidence hqc-review-2026-11-23. Cumulative baseline: application source ac24c18 / immutable 99efba8e (nov17-pedro-followup-v2) and every earlier accepted 12/13/17 Nov requirement remain in force. Preview only; production hold, legal sign-off and client acceptance remain separate.

Apply the PDF's Implementation checklist to Terms data exactly as written: new 'HQC service commitment and re-clean' section after s4 (48h); replace s10 with 14-day right to cancel plus model cancellation form; three s8 additions (discount balance not charged on HQC material failure; replace second paragraph of Rescheduled or skipped visits with three consecutive cancelled visits wording; new Price changes for recurring clients); replace only the four client cancellation rows of the s11 table with fixed tiers (0/25/50/100%) plus the paragraph below it, keeping other approved rows; add Payment, VAT and quotations wording to s7 and 30-day quotation validity to s4 (Pedro's exact Stripe wording is authoritative for Terms s7 only; Privacy stays supplier categories); replace s26 with damage/valuables/photos keeping the unlawful-liability sentence; new keys, codes and alarms section after s14 (GBP500); add precedence to s1, complaints 2/10 working days to s24, copy-of-Terms text to s31; replace s33 Contact with the exact six lines including VAT 519 1014 22; commercial clients schedule C1-C4 at the end; renumber all sections and update internal cross-references; header 'Last updated: 23 November 2026'. HOLD s27 Insurance and s15/s18 unchanged pending insurance renewal. Preserve every other approved clause, the approved s5 and s7 booking-system paragraph, and Privacy unchanged.
Add 'VAT registration number: 519 1014 22' to the existing footer company details only, in the existing style.
Publish the new Terms as a dated, fixed-address PDF at /terms-2026-11.pdf generated from the same Terms content, without altering the HTML page. Preview only until Pedro signs off.

Add Pedro's exact 14-day early-start tick-box text to the request-a-quote route: show and require it only for home (consumer) routes when the required/desired service date is within 14 days of today; otherwise hidden and not submitted. Pass it through the existing form allowlist and readable summary as an additive field. Do not change other fields, routing, consent, webhook destinations or success behaviour.

Scope check while editing; update only the stale assertions in the existing Pedro audit test that the newer Terms supersede (Stripe in Terms s7, renumbered booking section), keeping all Privacy/Automaid/Launch27 protections; add Terms 2026-11 regression tests and an early-start form test. Run forms, analytics, corrections and revision suites, then review build. Independent other-provider hunk review. Non-production Pages preview, desktop/mobile captures of Terms, homepage footer and Request a Quote (with tick-box shown), append a new version to the review room without altering earlier versions.

Record status, checks, holds and evidence in phase8/REVIEW_CORRECTIONS_2026-11-23.md, revisions/acceptance-2026-11-23.json and revisions/versions.json. No private email text, access codes or links. No client send, provider write, live submission or production release.
